Greetings, We have organised a Shiv Sanchar Sena Summit wherein we were looking at 5 star hotels to organize a event and we were not able to execute the event till almost 2 days back also we were not able to finalize the venue hence falling short on time. While browsing for venues we came over the company by the name "BookEventz". After we contacted them, It was all hassale free they also helped us finalize the venue and all the elements. They helped us organize the event in such a smooth fashion that now at the end of the event i am very satisfied with their services and the event was very well organized so kudos to Team BookEventz and In the future i recommend if you have any events coming up do contact them their team is very hospitable and friendly, Therefore much recommended.


SHIV SANCHAR SENA


TransIndia Group Testimonial
According to my experience the event was really nice, specially i would like to thank your team to be like a part of our TransIndia family and everything went flawless, very smoothly thats what i liked. Rating : Out of 5 i would like to give you a 6. One word for BookEventz fantastically engaging. Feedback : You guys are doing really great also you guys have a very beautiful design sense and a good flow of action.


TRANSINDIA GROUP


Livlong, Tunga International Hotel
Hi, Everyone we basically had to do this event on a very short notice and i was scouting place around Andheri Thats where i met Azhar from BookEventz, he personally came with me and showed me the venues and we closed in like the same day and in two day's time the event was done and it was organized really well. Hundred people on such short notice and it was nicely done. I think this will go a long way and most of our events will be going to BookEventz now.




RXO, Holiday Inn
Hi. This is Praful. I'm very grateful and thankful to the BookEventz Team. Especially, Abhishek and Sajid. Well, they managed our RXO annual party very well. The decor the theme was, very properly designed within the given timeline. As well as the guys have done a really good job start to end. Thanks to the complete BookEventz Team.

Hey. I'm Julie working for GNG Electronics Private Limited. So I'm connected with BookEventz from last two years. They organized us for Lonavala event, and this is the second event happening in Goa in Le Meridien. In regarding the arrangements and the whole event was organized by them. It was really good, and I really give a cheets to Sajid and Abhishek for giving me the best coordination and support regarding to every perspective. Yes, Looking forward for more, events to be coming up with them, globally, I would say. So yes. So cheers for BookEventz.




Shriram Life Insurance, Kohinoor Elite
The overall experience is very good. If you ask me for the rating, I will be five or five rating for the experience. Everything is well good. The Kohinoor Elite is every good suggestion. It is matched my expectations, like what I was expecting. Food quality is very good and taste is also very good. So I'll definitely put that to you for the, future events.




Anatek Services, West Block
Really very happy to know about Bookeventz, and it has been very nicely arranged, and food was also very good. We thoroughly enjoyed the event and overall the event was very successful and thank you so much for the arrangements and all the efforts.




Cult-Fit@Holiday Inn, Mumbai
So we had our event today for cult-fit and the entire event was fabulous. The sales staff called me and very humbly they took us around, showed us a couple of venues, and said that you don't worry, we will close this venue. We will give you the best price an you will only have to be there on the day of the event and that's what happened. We only arrived at the hotel on the day of the event and everything was set. The food was also delicious. Thank you Bookeventz Team




The overall experience with book events has been excellent. I would definitely recommend book events to friends, family, and relatives. You know, I think it's one of the most efficient ways of in finding out these venues and like you know, getting these kind of events small scale or big scale executed. Thanks book events for making this a great success.




So when we we went on to Bookeventz, it was a very hassle free experience. They are very proactive, very engaging. I will definitely recommend Bookeventz to other people, especially those people who want to have a very warm and engaging experience. Because end of the day, event is all about, celebrating your joy and it is important the event management people understand it.




Saima & Rashid's Wedding Reception @ Rajiv Gandhi Banquet Hall
I am the bride’s younger brother and I’m really surprised by the event that has been managed by BookEventz. It’s really nice and the best part is it’s free of cost. The food was really good and my friends really loved it. Thank you so much for the service.

All my wedding functions are finally over and all I want to say is thank you for an amazing experience. We were looking forward to this very special day and we had a lot of expectations from you guys. Today has been the most special day of my entire life and you guys are the major contributors to it.


SHREYA & RICKY

Since the first time, we have been amazed by the level of dedication and hard work which has been put into organizing our event by their team. I am really grateful for the fact that they sometimes even worked at odd hours for us! And, I would love to work with them in the future.
